# Imbalance exposure, stage 1: what makes up each forecaster's worst days (generated by worst_days.py)

Exploratory, added after stage 1's results and explore.py's were seen. Descriptive only: no intervals, no labels. A forecaster's worst days are its own worst 5% by daily net exposure (£ per GWh).

Days: 953. Share of all days flagged: clock change 1%, bank holiday 2%, Easter 1%, Christmas 2%, any calendar 5%, cold (T1) 10%, weekend 28%.
